title: One successful public business website per row
description: Emails and phones are published observations, not verified contacts. Empty arrays mean none found within the crawl limit. Each observed contact and technology has source evidence.

companyName.title: Published business name
companyName.description: Name from Organization JSON-LD or Open Graph site name; empty when unavailable.

emails.title: Observed emails
emails.description: Public mailto, visible-text or Organization JSON-LD addresses. No deliverability verification.

phones.title: Observed phone numbers
phones.description: Numbers from tel links and Organization JSON-LD. No location inference or verification.

socials.title: Social profile URLs
socials.description: Known-platform profile links, normalized and deduplicated. Share/intent endpoints are excluded.

technologies.title: Observed website technologies
technologies.description: Conservative HTML signatures; names, category, evidence and sourceUrl are included.

evidence.title: Source evidence
evidence.description: Each entry includes type, value, sourceUrl and extraction method.

pagesAttempted.title: HTML page attempts
pagesAttempted.description: Homepage plus attempted contact pages, including failed, blocked or duplicate-redirect attempts. Robots requests and redirect hops are not additional page attempts.

contactPageLimitReached.title: More discovered contact pages remain
contactPageLimitReached.description: True when the configured page-attempt budget was reached with unvisited same-site contact links remaining. False does not mean all website pages were crawled.

pageDiagnostics.title: Per-page results
pageDiagnostics.description: Requested URL, final URL when available, status, HTTP status and failure message for each attempted HTML page. A successful website may have failed contact pages.
